research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Series re-examines evidence where individuals maintain innocence; often features new forensic analysis or testimony. Available via NBC/Peacock.
research_notes_other.research_findings: "Conviction" appears to be a Dateline series/theme focusing on wrongful conviction investigations. A prominent multi-part series from 2016 focused on Richard Rosario. Other cases, like Christopher Tapp's, have been featured under different episode titles but fit the overall theme. A fictional 2006 NBC drama also shares the name "Conviction" but is unrelated.

contributing_factors_raw: Disregarded alibi witnesses (13 people placed him in Florida), potential eyewitness misidentification.
